v: Kuseltakxonhej ix ajkan chonhab' Jerusalén b'aj tzijtum anima t'a peka'. Lajan ix ajkan jun niwan chonhab' tik icha tz'ajkan junok ix ix toxo ix cham yetb'eyum. Ha t'a peka', ichato yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanh nación, haxo tiknaik, tz'ak'ji pural yoch t'a munlajel.

Lajan icha junok ix ix sik'sik'an yok' t'ak'walil, chalali wal yemta yal sat t'a spak'ultak sti'. Ha t'a skal juntzanh nación wach' yak'an yet'ok, manhxa junok tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ool. Masanil ix meltzajoch ajk'olal t'ay.

Ix ik'jib'at heb' aj Judá t'a ch'ok chonhab'il. K'ixwub'tak yaj heb' yuj munlajel te ya b'aj ayochi. Ayxoek' heb' t'a skal juntzanhxo nación. Maxtzak yik' jab'ok yip heb'. Ix yamchaj heb' yuj heb' spechani, yuj chi' ayxoek' heb' t'a skal yaelal.

Kuseltakxonhej yaj sb'eal Sion tiknaik. Manhxalaj mach sjawi t'a k'inh. Tz'inini yajkan sti' chonhab'. Haxonhej ok'el syak' heb' sacerdote. Ha heb' ix kob'estak taknakxonhej sk'ol heb' ix. Ha heb' aj Jerusalén ayoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb'.

Toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' kajan t'a Sion. Ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il yuj heb' yajk'ool. Ha Jehová ix ak'anoch yaelal t'a yib'anh heb', yujto te pit ix yutej sb'a heb'. Ha heb' yajk'ol heb' chi', wan sk'echaanh heb'.
Toxo ix satel swach'il yilji chonhab' Sion chi'. Ha heb' yajalil heb', lajan heb' icha nok' k'ultakil chej maxtzak ilchaj swael. Wan yel yip, yuj chi' toxonhej snher yok t'a yichanh heb' spechani.

Ha wal t'a sk'ual ayoch heb' aj Jerusalén yab'an syail, ix snaankot masanil sb'eyumal heb' t'a yalanhtaxo. Ayik ix yamchaj heb' yuj heb' yajk'ol chi', manhxa mach ix kolanel heb'. Ha wal yik tz'ilji heb' yuj juntzanhxo heb' yajk'ool, sb'uchji heb' yujto toxo ix telwi heb'.

Ha heb' aj Jerusalén chi', yelxo niwan schukal heb' ix yak'ochi, yuj chi' smoj wal syajjiel heb'. T'a peka' niwan yelk'och jun chonhab' chi' t'a yol sat heb' anima, haxo tiknaik, syaj heb', yujto toxo ix ilji sk'ixweltakil. Yuj chi' a heb' aj Jerusalén tz'ok' wal heb', toxonhej sk'ub'ejel sat heb' yuj k'ixwelal.

Te niwan chekel yaj schukal heb' kajan t'a Jerusalén chi', palta malaj tas sna heb' yuj tas ol jawok t'a yib'anh. Te satub'tak ix aj stelwi schonhab' heb', malaj mach sniwanan sk'ol heb'. Syal heb' anima ta': Mamin Jehová, ina wal ko yaelal, yujto a heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh syik'chaanh sb'a heb' onh yixtani, xchi heb'.

Ha heb' ajk'ool chi', toxo ix yikej masanil sb'eyumal heb' aj Jerusalén heb'. Ix yil wal heb' aj chonhab' chi' yoch lemnaj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yol stemplo Dios, haton juntzanh anima yalnak Jehová to max yal yochi.

Masanil heb' kajan ta' tz'ok' heb', tzek' heb' sayan swael. Toxo ix yak'b'at sb'eyumal heb' sk'exulok swael yik max cham heb'. Ix yalan heb': Mamin Jehová, kotanh k'elan t'ayonh yuj tas ix aj ko telwi. Il wal och a k'ol t'ayonh yuj ko yaelal.
Ha ex tzex ek' t'a ko lak'anil tik, ochanhek waan tze naani. ¿Tok ay wal yaelal icha kik tik? Yelxo wal sko te ab'ej syail. Ix yak'kot jun yaelal tik Jehová t'a kib'anh yuj yowal sk'ool.

Hato t'a satcha'anh ix yak'kot jun k'ak' Jehová, yik syak' lajwokem ko b'akil. Ix sb'oem jun yaal t'a kichanh, icha wal chi' ix aj ko meltzajkot t'a ko patik. Ix onh aktajkan yuj, kotak skal syak'anoch yaelal t'a kib'anh.

Ha Jehová, toxo ix yaloch ko chukal t'a ko sat, hanheja' ko chukal chi' ix onh tzek'ani, icha wal junok ikatz al yajoch t'a kib'anh. Tz'el wal kip yuj. Ix onh yak'och Dios Kajal t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'ool. Maxtzak yal ko tek'b'an ko b'a t'a yichanh heb'.

Ha Jehová ix spatikejel heb' soldado tzonh kolan kalani. Ix yak'kot jantak heb' soldado ajk'ol t'ayonh yik satel masanil heb' ko soldado kelemtak. Toxo ix onh tek'jiem a onh aj Judá onh tik yuj Jehová, icha wal tz'aj stek'jiel yal sat te' uwa.

Yuj wal juntzanh tik tz'el wal yal ko sat kok'i. Manhxalaj mach tz'ak'an sniwanil ko k'ool. Manhxalaj mach syal yak'an ko tek'anil. Ha t'a skal owal chi' ix kaktejkan heb' kuninal, yujto ix onh kan t'a yalanh yuj heb' ajk'ol chi'.

Ix kik'chaanh ko k'ab' ko tewi, palta malaj mach tz'ak'an sniwanil ko k'ool. Ha Jehová ix molb'ankot heb' kajan t'a ko lak'anil yik syak'an owal heb' ket'ok. Ha Jerusalén tik, yajyonk'olal ix ajkan t'a heb'.

Ix sk'ulej wal Jehová icha wal smojalil, yujto ix ko pitej ko b'a t'a scheknab'il. Ex chonhab', ab'ek wal tas ol kala'. Ilek wal ko yaelal. Ha heb' kuninal, toxo ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a ch'ok chonhab'il.

Ix ko k'an skolwal juntzanh nación ayoch ket'ok yalani, palta tonhej tzonh yixtej heb'. Ha heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh ichamtak winak, ayik wan yek' heb' winh say swael, ix cham heb' winh yuj wejel t'a yoltak scalleal chonhab' tik.

Mamin Jehová, ina wal tas kaji. Max techajlaj ko yaelal tik kuj skab'i. Pitz'itz'i yoch t'a ko k'ol skab'i ayik sko naankot ko pitalil. Ha t'a spatikel ko chonhab' tik smiljicham heb' kuninal t'a k'een espada, haxo t'a yol chonhab', ay pax chamel.

Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, syab' wal heb' yel kaw yuj ko kusk'olal, palta malaj mach sniwanan ko k'ool. Masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, yojtakxonhej ko yaelal heb', stzalaj wal heb' yuj yaelal ix ak'och t'a kib'anh. Jawokab' jun k'u alb'ilkan uj t'a peka', yik wach' lajan ol aj heb' icha kaj tik.
Nakot jantak schukal heb'. Utejpax heb' yuj schukal, icha wal tzonh utej yuj kik tik. Te niwanxo tzonh ok'i, tz'el yip ko pixan skab'i, xchi heb' aj Jerusalén chi' t'a Jehová.

Te wach' yilji chonhab' Sion, palta ix k'ik'b'i k 'inal t'ay yujto te niwan ix aj skot yowal sk'ol Jehová. Manh jantakok swach'il yilji Israel palta ix juwieli. Majxo snakotlaj skajnub' Jehová yuj yowal sk'ool chi'.

Manhxa junok chonhab' b'aj kajan heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jacob ixto kan yuj Jehová. Ha yuj yowal sk'ool, elanhchamel ix laj yak' lajwokem scuartel heb' aj Judá. Toxo ix satel sniwanil yelk'och jun nación yet' masanil heb' yajal yaj t'ay.

Yuj yowal sk'ol chi', ix yak' lajwok masanil yipal Israel. Ix yik'el skolwal t'ay ayik ix jawi heb' ajk'ool. Ix yak'och sk'ak'alk'olal t'a yib'anh yinhtilal winhaj Jacob, icha wal junok k'ak' satanel masanil tas.

Ha Jehová, lajan wal ix yutej sb'a icha junok ajk'ool, ix yak'b'at sjul-lab' t'a stojolal chonhab'. Icha wal junok milum anima, ix smilcham heb' xajan kuuj. Icha junok k'ak', icha wal chi' yajoch yowal sk'ol t'a yib'anh skajnub' heb' aj Sion.

Lajan ix sk'ulej Jehová icha wal sk'ulej junok ajk'ool, junelnhej ix lajwiem Israel yuj. Ix spojem masanil scuartel yet' sdespacho Judá. Tzololixonhej sjawi kusk'olal t'a yib'anh heb' aj Judá chi' yuj.

Icha tz'aj yixtajb'at junok lechpat, icha wal chi' ix aj yixtanb'at stemplo Jehová b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' chonhab'. Ha ix ak'an sb'atkan k'inh satk'olal yet' sk'ual ik'oj ip yuj heb' aj Sion. Ha yuj yowal sk'ol Jehová ix spatikejkanel heb' rey yet' heb' sacerdote.
Toxo ix spatikejel yaltar Jehová, manhxa yopisio stemplo yuj. Toxo ix yak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ool yik sjuchajem smuroal. Wal yel yaw heb' ajk'ol t'a stemplo Jehová, ichato sk'ual k'inh.
Ha Jehová ix naan sjuanem smuroal chonhab' Sion. Ix cham wal snaani tas ol aj sjuan lajwok. Maj ok'laj sk'ool masanto ix lajwiem yuj. Junxonhej ix aj yem juynaj storreal yet' smuroal.

Toxonhej ix emkan wekan spuertail jun chonhab' chi' t'a sat lu'um. Ix kanhchajpaxb'at yijchul ayochi. Ha winh sreyal yet' heb' ayoch yajalil, ix b'atkan heb' t'a skal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il b'aj malaj sk'ayb'ub'al Dios. Manhxalaj tas syak' Jehová yil heb' schekab'.

Ha heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Sion manhxalaj syal heb', k'ojanem heb' t'a sat lu'um. Syak'k'e pokok heb' t'a sjolom, syak'anoch pichul heb' yik kusk'olal. Ha heb' ix kob'estak ix t'a Jerusalén tz'em nhojan heb' ix t'a sat lu'um yuj k'ixwelal.
Ste ixtaxel in sat yuj ok'el, max techaj kusk'olal wuj swab'i. Manhxalaj in tek'anil yik swilan satel heb' wetchonhab'. Ha heb' unin tzato chuni, scham heb' t'a yoltak calle yuj wejel.
Syal heb' unin t'a snun icha tik: Ak' ko wael, ak' ko wino, xchi heb'. Ichato echen tz'ik'an heb', stelwi heb' t'a yoltak scalleal chonhab'. Tz'em nhojnaj heb' t'a yol sk'ab' snun, tz'el sk'ol heb'.
¿Mach yet'ok ol ex in lajb'ej ex aj Jerusalén? Ex aj chonhab' Sion, ¿tas junok ch'oxnab'il tzin ch'ox t'ayex yik swak'an sniwanil he k'ool? Te niwan ix aj he lajwiemi, ¿machto wal ol ex ak'an b'oxok?
Ha tas ix yal heb' syesejoch sb'a schekab'ok Dios t'ayex, es masanil. Maj ch'oxjiel he mul yuj heb', yuj chi' maj k'exwi he pensar. Ix alji es lolonel t'ayex, ix eyak'anoch t'a he k'ool.

Ayik tz'ilji Jerusalén yuj heb' tzek' t'a yol b'e, stz'it sk'ab' heb' sb'uchwaj t'ay. Tz'el yaw heb', stzikub'tanhan sat heb' sb'uchwaji. Syalan heb' icha tik: ¿Tob'an am a jun chonhab' tik sb'inaj t'a sat lum tik to manhxo jantakok swach'il yilji? xchi heb'.

Masanil heb' ajk'ol sb'uchwaj t'ay, tz'el yaw heb', schinhan sk'ab' heb', syalan heb' icha tik: Toxo ix ko satel Jerusalén t'a junelnhej. Haton jun k'u tik ix ko tanhwej wal, a tiknaik wan kilani, xchi heb'.

Toxo ix elk'och tas nab'il yuj Jehová, toxo ix elk'och slolonel nab'il yuj t'a peka'. Ix onh yak' sateli, majxo ok'laj sk'ol t'ayonh. Ix el t'a sk'ol onh yak'an tzetzajok, ix schaan yik'chaanh sb'a heb' ajk'ol chi'.
Ex aj Sion, k'anek skolwal Jehová t'a smasanil he k'ool. k'ual t'ak'wal okab' yel yal he sat eyok'i. Manh ex och waan eyok'i.

Kotak skal tzex k'e waan, tzex awaj t'ak'walil, tze k'anan skolwal Jehová. Mojb'ejekk'e he k'ab' tzex ok' t'a smasanil he k'ol t'a yichanh Jehová. k'anek yok'elk'olal yuj heb' eyuninal, yujto a b'aj schalaj sb'a b'e wan scham heb' yuj wejel.

Mamin Jehová, nawal sik'lab'il, ¿tok ay junokxo chonhab' tzutej icha tik? ¿Tokwal smoj ay heb' ix nunab'il schianb'at yune' tzato chuni? ¿Tok wal smoj smak'jicham heb' sacerdote yet' heb' a chekab' t'a yol a templo?

Ha heb' unin yet' heb' ichamtak winak, toxo ix em latz'an heb' t'a yoltak calle schami. Ha heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ix kob'estak, ix cham heb' yuj k'een espada. T'a sk'ual yowal a k'ool ix a mak'cham heb', majxo ok'laj a k'ol t'a heb'.

Mamin Jehová, yalxonhej b'aj ix ik'kot tzijtum yaelal t'a Jerusalén, icha wal tz'aj sjawi heb' anima t'a sk'ual k'inh. Manhxalaj mach ix kolchajel t'a sk'ual yowal a k'ol chi'. Ha heb' kuninal ix kil k'ib'ok, heb' ix ko k'ayb'ej, ix miljicham heb' yuj heb' ajk'ool.
Ha in tik, niwan wal ix aj wab'an syail yuj yowal sk'ol Dios.
Ix in spechb'at t'a skal k'ik' k'inal b'aj junelnhej k'ik'olinak. Ix in yak' b'ey t'a yoltak b'e b'aj malaj sakil k'inal.
Masanil k'u ichanhej tik in smak'an yet' yowal sk'ool.
Ix yak' ichamax in niwanil, chok'xonhej ix yutejkanb'at in b'akil.
Ix in smakchej yet' yaelal yet' kusk'olal.
Ix in yak' aj t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, icha yaj heb' chamnakxo.
Ix in smakchej b'aj manhxa b'aj syal weli. Yet' wal k'een niwak cadena ix in stzek'a'.
Wach'chom tz'el waw in k'anan skolwal, max scha yab' tas tzin k'an t'ay.
Ix smak in b'e yet' k'een k'een, yuj chi' haxonhej t'a k'ex b'e tzin b'ati.
Lajan ix yutej sb'a Jehová t'ayin icha junok nok' oso sk'ub'ejel sb'a, icha junok nok' choj tz'elta juknaj t'ayin.
Ix in snherel t'a yol b'e yik chok' tzin yutejkanb'ati, ix in aktajkan yuj.
Ix sb'o'okh sjul-lab', ix kan ijan t'ayin yet' sjul-lab' chi'.
Ha sjul-lab' ix sjulkot t'ayin, ix k'axpaj t'a yol in k'ool.
Masanil heb' wetanimail sb'uchwaj t'ayin, a inxonhej tzin yal heb' t'a skal slolonel.
T'a wal syaelal ix in ajek' yuj Dios. Te k'a' tas ix yak' wuk'ej.
Ix el weknaj k'een we ayik ix in em latnaj t'a sat lum yuj, ix in kan telan t'a kal pokok.
Manhxalaj in junk'olal, manhxo naanok tzalajk'olal wuuj.
Swalani to manhxa in tek'anil, yujto manhxo ayokoch Jehová yipok in k'ool.
Ha tzin naankot in kuselal yet' wek' in ch'okojil, te ya swab'i.
Ha wal yik tzin naankot juntzanh chi', manhxo animaok tzin aj swab'i.
Palta ay jun tas tzin nib'ej, aynhejek' t'a in pensar, haton jun chi' in gana swak'nhejoch yipok in k'ool.
Haton wal yuj swach'k'olal Jehová max onh sateli, yujto tz'ok'nhej sk'ool t'ayonh.
Junjun k'inhib'alil scheklaj swach'k'olal Jehová, syalnhej kak'anoch t'a ko k'ool.
Yuj chi' swala' to icha in makb'en yaj Jehová, anhej ayoch yipok in k'ool.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová t'a sk'ool, te wach' Jehová chi' t'a heb', haton heb' to sb'ek wal och sb'a t'a yol sk'ab'.
Te wach' tato numan tzonh aj ko tanhwani masanto skolwaj Jehová t'ayonh.
Yelxo wach' tato ayik unin animaonhto skak'anoch ko b'a t'a yalanh smandar Dios.
Wach' tato numan tzonh aj ko ch'okoj yakb'an syak'och ko yaelal Jehová.
Yowalil tzonh och ejmelal, tzonh em nhojan t'a sat lu'um, talaj tz'ok' sk'ol Jehová t'ayonh.
Wach'chom tzonh mak'ji, tzonh b'uchji, palta ko chaokab'i.
Max onh yaktejkan Jehová t'a junelnhej.
Wach'chom syak'och ko yaelal, palta tz'ok'pax sk'ool t'ayonh, yujto te niwan swach'k'olal.
Wal yel malaj snib'ej syak'och ko kusk'olal yet' ko yaelal.
Ha Jehová Dios Haxonhej Ochi, malaj snib'ej tz'ixtaj heb' anima t'a preso,
malaj pax snib'ej tz'ik'jiel sderecho heb' ak'b'il yuj.
Manh wach'ok t'a sat Dios tato max ch'olb'itaj heb' anima t'a stojolal.
Max elk'ochlaj tas sko na' tato manhok Jehová tz'alani.
Max jawilaj wach'ilal ma yaelal, tato manhok Dios Haxonhej Och tz'alani.
¿Tas yuj chuk skab'i tato yuj ko chukal syak' ko yaelal Dios?
Ko b'eyk'olejek wal ko b'a sik'lab'il, chajtil yilji ko b'eyb'al, skak'anxioch ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová.
Kak'ekb'at ko pensar t'a Dios aj satcha'anh, skalan t'a ko lesal icha tik:
Ix och ko mul, ix ko pitej ko b'a t'ayach, maj onh ak' niwank'olal.
Ix jawi yowal a k'ol t'ayonh, ix onh a pechani, ix onh a sateli, majxo ok'laj a k'ool t'ayonh.
Ix a k'ub'ejel a b'a, najat ach b'atkan t'ayonh yik maxtzak ab' ko lesal.
Icha k'alem ix onh utej t'a skal masanil anima.
Masanil heb' kajk'ool, ix onh sb'uchwal heb'.
Tzonh te xiwi yujto a heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh tzonh syam heb', tzonh yixtan heb', tzonh satanel heb', xko chi.
Tz'el wal jiljon yal in sat wok' yuj kusk'olal, yujto wan satel heb' wetchonhab'.
Manh ol waktej wok' yuj wab'annhej syail
masanto ol yak'kot swach'k'olal Jehová t'ayonh t'a satcha'anh.
Te yaxo pax swab' yet' in pixan yuj tas tzek' t'a yib'anh heb' ix ix t'a yol in chonhab'.
Ha heb' ajk'ool, tzin spech heb' wach'chom malaj jab'ok in mul. Icha tz'aj spechji junok nok' much icha chi' tzin yutej heb'.
Pitzan in wal ix in syumanem heb' t'a yol jun jul, ix smakankan sti' jun jul chi' heb' yet' jun k'een k'een, manhxa b'aj syal weli.
Ichato ay in em t'a yol ha ha', ix in naani to yikxo chamel waji.
Mamin Jehová, hato t'a sjulal yich jun jul tik tzin awaj t'ayach.
Ab' yoch in jaj, manh aktej ab'an in tewi.
Ix a nitzkot a b'a t'ayin ayik ix ach wawtani, ix halan t'ayin: Manh ach xiwok, xa chi.
Mamin, ix in a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak tas tzin utaj t'a manh stojolalok tik. B'o yaj t'ayin t'a stojolal.
Ojtak tas snib'ej heb' ajk'ol t'ayin yet' tas sna heb' tzin yutej.
Mamin Jehová, ix ab' jantak chukal syal heb' t'a in patik yet' jantak tas sna heb' tzin yutej.
Jun k'u syak' heb' in yalub'tanhani, snaan heb' tas ol in yutok.
Ilnab' wal, k'ual t'ak'wal in sb'uchan heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ak' spak t'a heb' icha wal smojalil yuj tas tzin yutej.
Ak' pitb'okel spensar heb', tzak'anb'at katab' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Mamin, pech heb' yet' yowal a k'ool. Satel heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ina wal tas ix aj sk'ik'b'i yilji skopopial k'een oro te wach'. Masanil k'een k'een wach' yilji t'a templo, sakleminak ix ajkanb'at k'een t'a yoltak calle.
Ha heb' kelemtak t'a chonhab' Sion, te nib'ab'il heb' t'a yichanh k'een oro wach'. Haxo tiknaik jun, lajan tz'utaj heb' icha junok lum komon chen.
Ha nok' nun okes syak' chunok yune' nok', haxo pax heb' ix wetchonhab' tik, maxtzak ok' sk'ol heb' ix, lajan heb' ix icha nok' avestruz tzek' t'a takinh lu'um syaktejkan snholob'.
Ha heb' unin wanto schuni scham heb' yuj takinhtial, sk'ekan lotzan yak' heb' t'a sjoom. Sk'an swael heb' unin chi', palta malaj mach tz'ak'an t'a heb'.
Ha heb' anima tzijtum tas swa t'a peka', wan scham heb' yuj wejel t'a yoltak calle tiknaik. Ha heb' ix k'ib' t'a yoltak pat te wach' yilji, wan sayan heb' tas syab'lej t'a skaltak k'alem.
Ha yaelal ix jawi t'a yib'anh in chonhab' yuj schukal, te ek'to t'a yichanh yik heb' aj Sodoma. Ha Sodoma chi', junnhej rato satnakeli, malaj mach kusnak yuj.

Ha heb' yajal t'a ko kal, kopopi yilji heb' t'a yichanh k'een sakb'akom, te sak yilji heb' t'a yichanh lech. Te chak yilji sniwanil heb' t'a yichanh k'een coral. Te wach' yilji heb' t'a yichanh k'een zafiro.

Haxo tiknaik, te k'ik' yilji heb' t'a yichanh k'ik'b'alil. Ha mach tz'ilan heb' t'a yoltak calle, maxtzak nachaj yuj heb' mach heb'. Toxo ix och lotzan stz'umal heb' t'a sb'akil, takinhxonhej heb' icha te' k'atzitz.
Te wach' yik mach ix cham t'a owal t'a yichanh mach k'ojank'olal ix cham yuj wejel.
Yuj wejel ix jawi t'a yib'anh in chonhab' yuj owal, a heb' ix ix wach' spensar smilcham yune' heb' ix, stz'anhan heb' ix schi'a.
Ix elk'och jantak yowal sk'ol Jehová, ix yak'kot sk'ak'alk'olal. Ix yak'anoch sk'ak'al chonhab' Sion, masanto ix yal slajwiem cimientoal.
Ha heb' sreyal juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' heb' kajan t'ay, maj sna heb' tato ay heb' ajk'ol ol yal yoch t'a yol chonhab' Jerusalén.
Icha chi' ix uji yuj smul heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' heb' sacerdote. Ix tob'kanb'at schik'il anima malaj smul yuj heb'.
Haxo tiknaik, tonhej smachlej heb' tzek' heb' t'a yoltak calle icha heb' max uji yilani. Kenhechtak spichul heb' yuj chik', manhxa mach syal sk'ol syaman spichul heb' chi'.
Manh ex jawok t'a ko tz'ey, yujto te chik'tak ex, manh onh eyama', xchi heb' yetchonhab' heb' t'ay. Yuj chi' ix b'at heb' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab', palta malaj mach schaan heb'.
Yet' yowal sk'ol Jehová ix yak' saklemb'at heb', majxo tanhwaj heb' yuj. Manhxalaj yelk'och heb' sacerdote t'a yol sat heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, majxo ok'laj sk'ol heb' t'a heb' ichamtak winak.
Nab'anhej ix onh k'unb'i ko maklan sjawi jun chonhab' onh skolo'. Ayonhk'e t'a chaanh sko maklan kil sjawi jun nación ijan ix onh kolan yalani, palta maj yalpaxlaj yuj.
Aynhejoch sat heb' ajk'ol t'ayonh b'aj tzonh b'eyek'i. Max yal-laj kelb'at t'a yol chonhab'. Wan sjawi slajwub'al ko k 'inal, toxo ix jawi ko chamel.
Ha heb' tzonh pechani, te jelan sb'ey heb' t'a yichanh nok' ch'akb'a tzek' jenhenhok. Tzak'annhej heb' t'a ko patik t'a jolomtak witz, tzonh makji yuj heb' t'a tzinan lu'um.
Ha winh ko reyal ayoch yipok ko k'ool, winh sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová, toxo ix yamchaj winh yuj heb'. Ha sko naani to a winh ol onh kolan t'a juntzanhxo nación.

Ex aj Edom, ex tzeyak' yajalil t'a masanil smakb'en chonhab' Uz, tzewajanhek, tzalajanhek yakb'an tzato yala'. Ol k'ochpax yaelal t'a eyib'anh. Icha heb' uk'um anh ol ex ajok, k'ixwelal ol ex ajkanok.
Ex aj Sion, toxo ix ek'b'at jantak eyaelal. Manhxo ol ex ak'jokxib'at t'a preso yuj Jehová. Ha exxo tik ex aj Edom, yuj he chukal ol yak'pax eyaelal Jehová, ol yak' cheklaj jantak he mul.
Mamin Jehová, nakot jantak tas ix ek'b'at t'a kib'anh, ina wal tz'aj kixtaji.
Masanil ko makb'en, ix yikej heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, haxo ko pat yikxo heb' yaji.
Mheb'a' unin ix onh ajkani, manhxalaj ko mam. Haxo heb' ix ko nun, toxo ix kan heb' ix sch'okojil, manhxalaj yetb'eyum heb' ix.
Ha ha ha' skuk'ej, sko man ha', haxo te' ko k'atzitz, sko tup te'.
Aynhejoch heb' ajk'ol onh spechan b'eyek'ok. Tzonh te k'unb'i, palta maxtzak yal kik'an jab'ok kip yujto ijanoch heb' t'a ko patik.
Ix b'at b'echanh ko k'ab' t'a heb' aj Egipto yet' t'a heb' aj Asiria, yuj ko k'anan jab'ok ko wael yik max onh chami.
Ha heb' ko mam kicham ochnak smul, palta chamnakxo heb', haxo t'a kib'anh skotkan yaelal yuj smul heb' chi'.
Ha tiknaik ayonh och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch chekab'ok t'a yalanhtaxo. Manhxalaj mach tzonh kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Skal xiwk'olal sb'at ko say jab'ok ko wael, yujto ay smay yuj heb' ak'um owal t'a tzinan lu'um.
Yuj sk'ak'al wejel tzonh te k'ik'b'i.
T'a Sion yet' t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, tz'ixtaj heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' ix kisil.
Ix k'e t'unhan heb' kajalil yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh. Manhxa yelk'och jab'ok heb' ichamtak winak t'a yol sat heb'.
Ha heb' winh kelemtak tek'an, tz'ak'jioch heb' winh t'a jaxoj harina, haxo heb' winh yunetak kelem, stelwi heb' winh t'a yalanh te' k'atzitz.
Manhxalaj heb' winh ichamtak winak ayek' t'a sti' chonhab' sb'oan yaj yowal heb' anima. Manhxalaj heb' winh kelemtak sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal.
Manhxalaj ko tzalajk'olal. Ha ko chanhal yik tzalajk'olal, ix meltzajoch kusk'olalil.
Maxtzak onh b'inaj icha t'a peka'. Te ob'iltak onh, yujto ix och ko mul.
Manhxa yip ko pixan yuj kusk'olal, wan yixtax yol ko sat yuj ok'el.
Yujto ix satjiel stemplo Dios t'a tzalan Sion, yuj chi' haxonhej nok' waax tzek' ta'.
Palta a ach pax tik ach Jehová, Yajal achnhej, aynhej ek' opisio t'a masanil k 'inal.
¿Tas yuj tzonh b'atkan satk'olal uj t'a junelnhej? ¿Tas yuj te niwanxo tiempo ix onh aktejkani?
Mamin Jehová, ik'onhxi meltzaj t'ayach, ol onh meltzajxok. Komonok wach' tzonh ajxi icha t'a yalanhtaxo.
Palta ina ix onh a patikejkaneli. Ix ek' t'a yib'anh ak'ankot yaelal t'a kib'anh.
